mapper.select: SELECT mark.* FROM torn_stock_batch_mark mark JOIN torn_stock_virtual_batch batch ON batch.id = mark.batch_id AND batch.deleted = 0 WHERE mark.round_time >= #{startTime} AND mark.round_time < #{endTime} AND mark.deleted = 0 AND (mark.dynamic_shadow_decision IS NOT NULL OR mark.dynamic_shadow_reason IS NOT NULL) AND batch.ledger_type IN ('FORMAL', 'SHADOW_FORMAL_CANDIDATE') AND ( batch.batch_status IN ('ENTRY_PENDING', 'OPEN', 'DATA_STALE', 'EXIT_PENDING', 'DATA_STALE_EXIT') OR (batch.entry_time >= #{startTime} AND batch.entry_time < #{endTime}) OR (batch.exit_time >= #{startTime} AND batch.exit_time < #{endTime}) ) ORDER BY mark.round_time ASC, mark.id ASC
